title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 6.109
exact_target:
For an analytic univalent $f$ in the unit disk and $\lambda>0$, set
\[I_{-\lambda}(r,f')=\left(\frac1{2\pi}\int_0^{2\pi}|f'(re^{i\theta})|^{-\lambda}\,d\theta\right)^{1/\lambda}.\]
Determine the maximal growth rate as $r\uparrow1$. In particular, for $\lambda=2$, must it be $O((1-r)^{-1/2})$, the rate of the Koebe function?
